title: Sable and the Oath
premise: Sebastian Ashgrove, last apprentice of the Ashgrove wardens, has spent his life in a valley where magic cannot enter — the only safe place left after the kingdom of Sable was erased from history. When his date, Mara Venn, is named in a century-old prophecy and dragged into Sable's ghost-country, he must break his guild's final oath and follow her into a land that feeds on memory. To escape, they must reach the Door of Unmaking before Sable's dying king consumes their pasts to fuel his own survival; Sebastian sacrifices his memories of Mara to open it, and she carries him home carrying all the love he can no longer recall.
about_author: Jude Dunmore is the pen name of a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing letters from families separated by borders that no longer appear on maps. They write fantasy about ordinary people caught in the machinery of history.

chapters.title: The Valley That Forgets
chapters.summary: Sebastian's POV. He tends the valley's boundary stones on the eve of his first date in years, establishing the wardens' dying guild and the rule that magic cannot cross. Emotional beat: quiet loneliness beneath dutiful routine.

chapters.title: A Girl Named in Ink
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. Her date with Sebastian is warm and awkward until she glimpses her own name glowing in an old prophecy book in his study. Emotional beat: wonder curdling into dread.

chapters.title: The Taking
chapters.summary: Sebastian's POV. At midnight the valley's wards fail for the first time in a century; Mara is pulled through a seam of light while Sebastian clings to her hand and fails. Emotional beat: helpless loss.

chapters.title: Oath and Ashes
chapters.summary: Sebastian's POV. The last warden elder forbids pursuit: entering Sable means surrendering memories as toll. Sebastian burns the oath scroll and crosses anyway. Emotional beat: defiant grief.

chapters.title: The Country With No Name
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. She wakes in Sable, a beautiful ruined kingdom whose citizens cannot remember yesterday. A ferryman warns her the king eats memories to stay alive. Emotional beat: disorientation and fragile courage.

chapters.title: Tollgate
chapters.summary: Sebastian's POV. Crossing the border, he pays his first memory-toll — his mother's face — and arrives hollowed but determined. Emotional beat: the first taste of the price.

chapters.title: The Ferryman's Debt
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. The ferryman, Corvo, agrees to guide her to the Door of Unmaking in exchange for one happy memory per day of travel. Emotional beat: bargaining with erosion.

chapters.title: Reunion in Ruin
chapters.summary: Dual POV. Sebastian finds Mara; joy is undercut when she realizes he no longer remembers his mother. They argue about what survival is worth. Emotional beat: love tested by cost.

chapters.title: The King's Court of Yesterday
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. Captured and brought to court, she sees the king wearing other people's memories like jewels — including fragments of Sebastian's childhood. Emotional beat: horror at stolen intimacy.

chapters.title: What the Prophecy Left Out
chapters.summary: Sebastian's POV. A blind archivist reveals the prophecy names two figures: the girl who enters, and the boy who forgets. Sebastian learns his sacrifice is foretold. Emotional beat: dread of inevitability.

chapters.title: Escape Through the Bone Orchard
chapters.summary: Dual POV. A prison break through a forest of petrified memory-eaters; Corvo betrays them to buy back his own name. Emotional beat: trust shattered mid-flight.

chapters.title: The Lake of Small Kindnesses
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. Wounded, they shelter where Sable's forgotten dead linger. A child-ghost shows Mara how memories can be given, not only taken. Emotional beat: tenderness amid ruin.

chapters.title: Corvo's Choice
chapters.summary: Corvo's POV. Consumed by guilt, Corvo returns and reveals the Door opens only for someone willing to give up what they love most. Emotional beat: redemption purchased too late to be simple.

chapters.title: The King Hunts
chapters.summary: Sebastian's POV. The king, starving since Mara escaped, hunts them across the salt plains, devouring whole villages' pasts to track them. Emotional beat: relentless pursuit, mounting exhaustion.

chapters.title: One Day of Ordinary Love
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. Hiding in an abandoned inn, they steal one perfect day together — dancing, laughing, memorizing each other deliberately. Emotional beat: bittersweet happiness before the end.

chapters.title: The Toll Comes Due
chapters.summary: Sebastian's POV. The king corners them; Corvo dies buying time, and Sebastian pays memory after memory to keep them moving — his guild, his valley, his own name. Emotional beat: erosion becoming annihilation.

chapters.title: The Door of Unmaking
chapters.summary: Dual POV. They reach the Door, which demands the thing Sebastian loves most: every memory of Mara. She begs him not to; he lies and says there's another way. Emotional beat: heartbreak disguised as calm.

chapters.title: The Forgetting
chapters.summary: Sebastian's POV. He gives his memories of her to the Door, which shatters open. He walks through knowing her face but not why it breaks his heart. Emotional beat: devastating sacrifice.

chapters.title: The King Unmade
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. Refusing to leave the king fed, she turns the Door's hunger on him — offering him the one memory he never had: being loved without price. He dissolves, grateful. Emotional beat: mercy as victory.

chapters.title: Home, Hollow
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. She brings Sebastian through the closing seam into the valley, where the wards accept them both. He knows everyone but her. Emotional beat: rescue that feels like loss.

chapters.title: The Book Rewrites Itself
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. In the prophecy book, new ink appears: the story isn't finished. She begins writing their days down, reading them to him nightly, rebuilding what was taken page by page. Emotional beat: stubborn hope.

chapters.title: Sable and the Oath
chapters.summary: Sebastian's POV. Months later, a fragment returns unbidden — the sound of her laugh in an inn. He doesn't know the memory, but he chooses her again anyway. Emotional beat: love as decision, not recollection.
